decision_evidence.outcome: The practical distinction between being a chairman/vice chairman and a normal student was eliminated, undermining the clan's incentive structure.

personality_evidence.observation: Fang Yuan internally smiles knowing he has a witness prepared, but outwardly feigns shock and helplessness to let the situation play out on his terms.
personality_evidence.quote: Witness? Of course I do! I prepared it long ago.

personality_evidence.observation: Fang Yuan uses the Spring Autumn Cicada to suppress the Bamboo Gentleman, effectively killing a rare Rank four Gu worm without hesitation to pass the lie detection test.
Fang Yuan had anticipated the Footprint Gu test days in advance and deliberately kept his movements within the village, away from his secret cave.
personality_evidence.quote: He was confident, having predicted this. Thus, these few days he kept his activities within the village and did not go to the secret cave.

personality_evidence.observation: Fang Yuan walks out of the pavilion without any visible stress after deceiving everyone present, including senior clan figures.
personality_evidence.quote: Without losing a single drop of sweat, Fang Yuan walked out of the family head's pavilion safe and sound.

speech_evidence.pattern: Deliberate performance of vulnerability — feigning helplessness to manipulate the situation
speech_evidence.example: Fang Yuan showed an indignant expression, but finally gritted his teeth and said helplessly, 'No.'

speech_evidence.pattern: Terse, confident responses under interrogation — no elaboration, no defensiveness
speech_evidence.example: 'No!' Fang Yuan affirmed. / 'No idea.' / 'No.'

speech_evidence.pattern: Contemptuous internal tone toward opponents
speech_evidence.example: 'Come and test!' Fang Yuan laughed coldly at Jia Fu, walking towards him with his head lowered.

decision_evidence.situation: Jia Fu attempts to frame Fang Yuan as a scapegoat for Jia Jin Sheng's disappearance and demands proof of innocence.
decision_evidence.decision: Fang Yuan feigns helplessness and says he has no witness, allowing the academy elder to step forward as a credible defender rather than volunteering the information himself.
decision_evidence.reasoning: By appearing weak and letting others defend him, he avoids drawing attention to his own preparedness and lets the clan's political interests work in his favour.
decision_evidence.outcome: The academy elder vouches for him, and the Gu Yue clan closes ranks to protect Fang Yuan, neutralising Jia Fu's attempt.

decision_evidence.situation: Jia Fu produces the Bamboo Gentleman, a Rank four lie-detection Gu, to interrogate Fang Yuan directly.
decision_evidence.decision: Fang Yuan immediately agrees without hesitation, then secretly activates the Spring Autumn Cicada's aura to terrify and suppress the Bamboo Gentleman, rendering it unable to detect lies.
decision_evidence.reasoning: He had a trump card ready and calculated that agreeing confidently would appear innocent while the Spring Autumn Cicada's overwhelming aura would neutralise the threat.
decision_evidence.outcome: The Bamboo Gentleman shows no colour change after his lies; Fang Yuan is declared innocent. The rare Rank four Gu is effectively condemned to death as a side effect.

decision_evidence.situation: Days before the confrontation, Fang Yuan anticipated being investigated.
decision_evidence.decision: He restricted all his movements to within the village and did not visit his secret cave.
decision_evidence.reasoning: To ensure the Footprint Gu test, which traces 30,000 steps, would show nothing suspicious.
decision_evidence.outcome: The Footprint Gu test reveals only ordinary, innocent activity, fully clearing him.

personality_evidence.observation: Fang Yuan worked hard half the night, then continued cultivating after returning to the hostel, only sleeping at sunrise
personality_evidence.quote: He had worked hard for half the night yesterday, and after returning to the hostel, he still continued in his Gu Master cultivation, nurturing his aperture. When the sun had risen, only then did he sleep.

personality_evidence.observation: Before entering the tunnel, Fang Yuan checked rock powder he had spread to detect any intrusions or unusual activity during his absence
personality_evidence.quote: The passage entrance's rock powder is intact, thus it seems that during my absence, nothing strange has crawled out of it.

personality_evidence.observation: After the rabbit served its purpose as a probe, Fang Yuan killed it immediately to prevent it from returning and attracting attention
personality_evidence.quote: He could not let the rabbit go, for animals also had memories. If it came back again, and like the Liquor worm, attracted outsiders, that would be very bad.

personality_evidence.observation: Fang Yuan's knowledge of weaving grass ropes comes from a past life where he was so poor he had to sell woven goods to survive
personality_evidence.quote: Having no choice, he learned to weave the grass ropes into straw sandals, hats etc. and sold them in exchange for primeval stone fragments to feed himself.

personality_evidence.trait: Philosophical equanimity / detachment from past suffering
personality_evidence.observation: Fang Yuan reflects on his past anguish and suffering without bitterness, transforming it into silent laughter
personality_evidence.quote: The anguish and suffering from back then had transformed into his soundless laughter now.

personality_evidence.trait: Risk-awareness / willingness to abandon goals for self-preservation
personality_evidence.observation: Fang Yuan openly considers abandoning the strength inheritance if the risk of exposure is too great
personality_evidence.quote: If the risk was too huge, he would rather give up this strength inheritance.

speech_evidence.pattern: Internal risk-benefit calculation stated plainly
speech_evidence.example: If the risk was too huge, he would rather give up this strength inheritance. After all, if others found out this secret, all the plotting and acting that Fang Yuan had done would go to waste, and his life would even be in danger!

speech_evidence.pattern: Calm, analytical self-assessment after physical exertion
speech_evidence.example: It is so troublesome without a detection Gu worm.

speech_evidence.pattern: Understated relief expressed as logical conclusion
speech_evidence.example: For now, it seems that this segment of the passageway is safe.

decision_evidence.situation: Needing to check whether the tunnel passage was safe before entering himself
decision_evidence.decision: Caught a wild rabbit, attached a bell and a grass rope to it, and sent it into the tunnel as a probe
decision_evidence.reasoning: The rabbit would trigger any physical traps and the bell would signal its movement; the rope allowed Fang Yuan to test whether it reached the end and to retrieve it
decision_evidence.outcome: The rabbit returned uninjured, confirming the immediate segment of the passage was safe

decision_evidence.situation: The rabbit had served its purpose as a probe and was no longer needed
decision_evidence.decision: Killed the rabbit immediately
decision_evidence.reasoning: Animals have memories; if released, the rabbit might return and, like the Liquor worm incident, attract outside attention to the secret cave
decision_evidence.outcome: The potential security risk was eliminated

decision_evidence.situation: A large collapsed rock blocked further progress in the tunnel, and breaking it would require tools and create noise that might reveal traces
decision_evidence.decision: Fang Yuan paused and weighed whether to proceed with tools or abandon the inheritance entirely
decision_evidence.reasoning: If others discovered the secret, all his prior scheming and acting would be wasted and his life would be endangered; self-preservation outweighs the inheritance's value
decision_evidence.outcome: No final decision yet; he was still deliberating at chapter's end

personality_evidence.observation: Fang Yuan avoided using tools like hammers or pickaxes to break the wall, using only the Moonlight Gu over six days, specifically to eliminate any suspicious sounds.
personality_evidence.quote: Fine details often decided in one's victory or defeat.

personality_evidence.trait: Caution as ingrained habit from past life
personality_evidence.observation: The narrative explicitly attributes his caution to 500 years of accumulated experience rather than natural personality.
personality_evidence.quote: 500 years of experience ingrained the word caution into his soul.

personality_evidence.observation: Fang Yuan waited over ten days after killing Jia Jin Sheng for attention to fade before returning to the cave, despite knowing about the inheritance.
Before entering the passage, Fang Yuan stood at the entrance and methodically analyzed what type of inheritance it could be, considering the possibility of traps.
personality_evidence.quote: Which type does Flower Wine Monk's inheritance belong to?

personality_evidence.observation: Fang Yuan deliberately spilled liquor on his clothes and carried wine back to the village to maintain his established cover as someone who drinks late at night.
personality_evidence.quote: If he did not return at night often, people would get suspicious.

speech_evidence.pattern: Internal self-motivation through gritted determination
speech_evidence.example: Continue working hard!

speech_evidence.pattern: Analytical internal monologue when assessing danger
speech_evidence.example: By right, the chances of a trap isn't high. Otherwise the Flower Wine Monk would not design this image wall. But is there a hidden mechanism?

decision_evidence.situation: Needed to break through the rock wall concealing Flower Wine Monk's inheritance without arousing suspicion.
decision_evidence.decision: Used only the Moonlight Gu to slowly shave the wall over six days instead of faster tools.
decision_evidence.reasoning: Steel hammers and pickaxes would create sound that could be heard and raise suspicion; eliminating all suspicious points was paramount.
decision_evidence.outcome: Successfully broke through after six days without detection.

decision_evidence.situation: Discovered a passage behind the broken wall but was uncertain if it contained traps.
decision_evidence.decision: Did not enter immediately; threw a rock in first, then spread rock powder at the entrance as a detection measure, and left without entering.
decision_evidence.reasoning: Wanted to test for hidden mechanisms before committing to entering; strength inheritances, especially demonic ones, can be lethal traps.
decision_evidence.outcome: Rock test showed no immediate danger; Fang Yuan deferred entry to a later time.

decision_evidence.situation: Needed to return to the village late at night without arousing suspicion about his nocturnal activities.
decision_evidence.decision: Spilled green bamboo wine on his clothes and carried the wine back, maintaining his established cover as a late-night drinker.
decision_evidence.reasoning: His prior behaviour of going out at night to find the Liquor worm had already established a pattern; reinforcing it prevented new suspicion.
decision_evidence.outcome: Returned to the school hostel at midnight without noted suspicion.

personality_evidence.observation: Fang Yuan acts as if he is 'risking everything' and speaks urgently, performing a carefully constructed narrative to dispel suspicion while concealing the truth
personality_evidence.quote: I shall not hide it any further!

personality_evidence.observation: Fang Yuan deliberately plants the idea that Jia Fu or Jia Gui might be the murderer, then stays silent once the elders pick up the thread, achieving his goal without further effort
personality_evidence.quote: To make someone believe in something wholeheartedly, it is not through convincing, but directing.

personality_evidence.observation: While showing an outward expression of indignance and stubbornness, Fang Yuan internally laughs coldly and observes the elders' reactions with keen detachment
personality_evidence.quote: his eyelids drooping, hiding away his cold gaze

personality_evidence.observation: Fang Yuan views dispelling suspicion as only the first step, already thinking ahead to what comes next
personality_evidence.quote: Getting rid of the suspicions on me is just the first step, what happens next is crucial.

speech_evidence.pattern: Deliberate provocation disguised as naive accusation to redirect suspicion
speech_evidence.example: Maybe Jia Jin Sheng was killed by you. I heard before that your family is splitting assets, now that one brother is dead, wouldn't you get more inheritance?

speech_evidence.pattern: Matter-of-fact deflection when questioned, projecting confidence
speech_evidence.example: So what?

speech_evidence.pattern: Internal cold commentary contrasting with outward emotional display
speech_evidence.example: Finally, they have thought of this.

decision_evidence.situation: Interrogated by clan elders and Jia Fu about the disappearance of Jia Jin Sheng, with suspicion pointing toward him
decision_evidence.decision: Fang Yuan chose to reveal a partial, carefully constructed truth about the Liquor worm and his encounters with Jia Jin Sheng, omitting his guilt
decision_evidence.reasoning: Revealing enough verifiable truth (corroborated by the female Gu Master witness) would make his overall account credible and dispel suspicion
decision_evidence.outcome: The elders accepted his account; suspicion was fully dispelled

decision_evidence.situation: Interrogation had reached a stalemate with no evidence against him, but suspicion still lingered
decision_evidence.decision: Fang Yuan provocatively accused Jia Fu of killing his own brother, then immediately went quiet after planting the idea
decision_evidence.reasoning: Directing the elders' thinking toward the Jia family internal dispute (Jia Gui as the real suspect) would shift suspicion away from himself entirely without him having to argue further
decision_evidence.outcome: The elders' imaginations ran with the Jia family dispute angle; all suspicion toward Fang Yuan was dispelled

personality_evidence.observation: Fang Yuan noticed subtle environmental details (darker soil color, wetness, loose soil texture) in dim lighting that revealed the hidden Earth Treasury Flower Gu
personality_evidence.quote: This huge rock blocking my path is too round and smooth, this is definitely man made.

personality_evidence.observation: Rather than rushing, Fang Yuan carefully and slowly peeled open the Earth Treasury Flower Gu petals, slowing his movements as the petals became more delicate
personality_evidence.quote: Fang Yuan's movements became gentler and slower, only opening a piece of petal in a few breaths.

personality_evidence.observation: After being blocked the previous night, Fang Yuan did not give up but reflected on what seemed amiss and returned with a new approach
personality_evidence.quote: He was discouraged by this setback the previous night, and on the way back to the village he felt something amiss.

personality_evidence.trait: High political and strategic intelligence (as assessed by Gu Yue Bo)
personality_evidence.observation: Gu Yue Bo internally acknowledges Fang Yuan as topping all youngsters he has seen in political wits
personality_evidence.quote: I've seen many youngsters these years, but when it comes to political wits, Fang Yuan tops them all. It is a pity he only has C grade talent.

personality_evidence.trait: Extreme, active, and invasive personality (as assessed by Gu Yue Bo)
personality_evidence.observation: Gu Yue Bo analyzes Fang Yuan's choice of the Little Light Gu as reflecting an aggressive, offensive disposition
personality_evidence.quote: He chose the Little Light Gu, this Gu is used to assist the Moonlight Gu and can make the moonblade attack stronger. This shows his extreme, active and invasive personality.

speech_evidence.pattern: Internal deductive reasoning stated as conclusions
speech_evidence.example: This huge rock blocking my path is too round and smooth, this is definitely man made. That is to say, the Flower Wine Monk purposely set this to block the path, but why did he set this hurdle at such a place?

speech_evidence.pattern: Controlled excitement expressed through focused action rather than words
speech_evidence.example: It really is what I'm thinking of! Fang Yuan's eyes shone, his hand movement becoming more delicate, carefully digging the surrounding soil away.

decision_evidence.situation: Blocked by a large smooth rock in the secret cave tunnel the previous night
decision_evidence.decision: Returned without tools the next day to carefully observe the environment instead of trying to break through by force
decision_evidence.reasoning: He sensed something was amiss on the way back and later realized during Gu refinement that the rock was deliberately placed, indicating a hidden clue rather than a simple obstacle
decision_evidence.outcome: Discovered darker, moist, loose soil near the rock that led him to uncover the Earth Treasury Flower Gu containing the White Boar Gu

decision_evidence.situation: Found the flower core of the Earth Treasury Flower Gu with only the final delicate layer of petals remaining
decision_evidence.decision: Paused his movements and slowed down rather than rushing to open the last petals
decision_evidence.reasoning: The petals had become increasingly thin and fragile, requiring extreme care to avoid damaging the Gu worm inside
decision_evidence.outcome: Successfully retrieved the White Boar Gu unharmed

personality_evidence.observation: Fang Yuan systematically examines every wall of the Gu storage room before making a decision, evaluating each Gu against his development path rather than taking the first appealing option.
personality_evidence.quote: The first time when he entered the Gu room, Fang Yuan already had an objective and chose the Moonlight Gu immediately. But now, he had several possible targets in his mind.

personality_evidence.observation: Fang Yuan demonstrates encyclopedic knowledge of Gu worm series, their market values, strengths, weaknesses, and compatibility without needing to consult any source.
personality_evidence.quote: Fang Yuan's knowledge was deep and broad, so of course he did not have any urge for this Gu.

personality_evidence.observation: Fang Yuan objectively evaluates his own physical constitution and rules out the Brute Force Longhorn Beetle Gu because it is incompatible with his small frame.
personality_evidence.quote: Only Gu Masters with a strong body would choose to use this Gu. A small-sized person like Fang Yuan was unsuitable for it.

personality_evidence.observation: Fang Yuan laughs off the absence of the rare Jade Skin Gu rather than feeling cheated, accepting the realistic limits of a mid-tier clan's storage room.
personality_evidence.quote: Gu Yue village is just a middle-sized clan, the academy Gu storage room is only of middle tier quality. To have a Jade Skin Gu, that is rather impossible.

personality_evidence.observation: Fang Yuan exits the storage room unhurried despite students outside growing restless and making mocking comments about his choices.
personality_evidence.quote: Fang Yuan leisurely walked out of the storage room.

speech_evidence.pattern: Self-directed musing aloud while evaluating options
speech_evidence.example: Iron Skin, Bronze Skin, Rock Skin, Jade Skin Gu….. if there is a Jade Skin Gu, I might as well choose it.

speech_evidence.pattern: Dry, matter-of-fact self-correction without disappointment
speech_evidence.example: Gu Yue village is just a middle-sized clan, the academy Gu storage room is only of middle tier quality. To have a Jade Skin Gu, that is rather impossible.

decision_evidence.situation: Choosing a second Gu from the academy storage room with first-pick priority
decision_evidence.decision: Passed over higher-profile options (Yellow Camel Longhorn Beetle, Brute Force Longhorn Beetle, Flower Boar Gu) and selected the modest Little Light Gu
decision_evidence.reasoning: None of the available Gu truly suited his development path; the Little Light Gu at least paired with his Moonlight Gu, making it a compatible if average choice
decision_evidence.outcome: Fang Yuan left with the Little Light Gu; Mo Chen, entering second, immediately took the Yellow Camel Longhorn Beetle that Fang Yuan had passed on

personality_evidence.observation: Fang Yuan analyzes his political position within the clan system, recognizing that appearing weak is a safety umbrella and that the longer he delays open conflict, the more he benefits
personality_evidence.quote: Fang Yuan knows that this conflict would escalate, but the later it escalated, the greater benefit he would gain.

personality_evidence.trait: Preference for independence over factional allegiance
personality_evidence.observation: Fang Yuan deliberately chooses to work alone and avoid the clan system, viewing those within it as pawns subject to others' control
personality_evidence.quote: Inside the system, one is a pawn. You first have to be a proper pawn for others to use you willingly.

personality_evidence.observation: Fang Yuan calculates his daily primeval stone expenditure precisely and immediately devises a plan to hunt wild boars to feed the White Boar Gu and reduce costs without attracting suspicion
personality_evidence.quote: If he hunted himself, it would not only resolve this problem, but also alleviate his current financial stress.

personality_evidence.trait: Secrecy as a core operating principle
personality_evidence.observation: Fang Yuan explicitly articulates that working secretly is always preferable to acting openly, and structures his plans around avoiding attention
personality_evidence.quote: This world's matters, it is always easily done secretly, but difficult to do openly.

personality_evidence.observation: Fang Yuan acknowledges that his C grade talent makes him undesirable to the clan as an investment and would cause him to be treated as a disposable pawn
personality_evidence.quote: The more crucial part was his C grade talent. To the clan, there was no desire in investing in him. Often he would be treated as a discarded pawn.

speech_evidence.pattern: Calm, direct ordering with forward-planning embedded in routine requests
speech_evidence.example: Then give me a jar of rice wine and tell the innkeeper, brew more green bamboo wine this year, I am pre-ordering a hundred jars. As for how much the advance payment will be, you can count first and report to me.

speech_evidence.pattern: Decisive, terse action-ending statements once a decision is made
speech_evidence.example: Shop assistant, bill!

decision_evidence.situation: Green bamboo wine is sold out at the inn
decision_evidence.decision: Accepts the substitute without complaint and immediately pre-orders a hundred jars for future supply
decision_evidence.reasoning: The Liquor worm is now openly known so he no longer needs to be restrained in purchasing wine; securing future supply is practical
decision_evidence.outcome: Arranges a standing order with the innkeeper

decision_evidence.situation: Fang Yuan needs large quantities of pork to feed the White Boar Gu but buying it from the village would be costly and attract suspicion
decision_evidence.decision: Decides to go hunting wild boars himself during the academy break
decision_evidence.reasoning: Hunting resolves both the feeding problem and financial stress without drawing attention that bulk pork purchases would invite
decision_evidence.outcome: Fang Yuan leaves the inn immediately to scout the mountains and hunt wild boars

decision_evidence.situation: Fang Yuan recognizes that continued resource competition will eventually invite suppression from clan factions
decision_evidence.decision: Chooses to use the Flower Wine Monk's inheritance as a hidden resource to cultivate outside the clan system
decision_evidence.reasoning: Working alone avoids factional strife, sustains his image as a weak C grade student, and lets him accumulate strength secretly until he is ready to leave Qing Mao Mountain
decision_evidence.outcome: Decision framed as optimal path; extortion to continue to avoid suspicion and maintain primeval stone income

personality_evidence.observation: Fang Yuan walked through the mountain forest patiently and became more careful as he moved further from the village, aware of the dangers.
personality_evidence.quote: The further he got from the village, walking towards the outer surroundings, the more risky it was. Thus Fang Yuan was even more careful.

personality_evidence.observation: When his scouting in the mountain proved unfruitful, Fang Yuan quickly changed his plan and headed to the mountain foot instead.
personality_evidence.quote: Fang Yuan's scouting was unfruitful, thus he changed his mind and went to the mountain foot.

personality_evidence.observation: Upon discovering the hunter's trap, Fang Yuan immediately recognized the broader danger traps posed to him and devised a plan to gather intel from an old hunter.
personality_evidence.quote: It seems I have to find an old hunter's residence and find out about the trap locations from him.

personality_evidence.trait: Calm detachment toward death and violence
personality_evidence.observation: Fang Yuan watched the wild boar bleed out with a calm face and reflected philosophically rather than showing any emotional disturbance.
personality_evidence.quote: Survival or death, this is the theme of nature.

personality_evidence.observation: Fang Yuan recognized he was benefiting from another hunter's trap and accepted it without guilt, though he noted the irony.
personality_evidence.quote: This trap is obviously set by hunters. To think I'm reaping the rewards.

speech_evidence.pattern: Internal analytical monologue — assessing resources and their practical value
speech_evidence.example: Beehive has honey, and honey is the Bear Strength Gu's food. Thus, the Xiong family has great demand for honey. This beehive is only a small-sized one, and the chances of producing a Gu isn't high. If I had the Bronze Skin Gu, I could risk getting stabbed and collect the honey. What a pity.

speech_evidence.pattern: Internal monologue — self-aware acknowledgment of limitations and planning around them
speech_evidence.example: This is the problem of not having a scouting-type of Gu worm. But to find a good scouting-type Gu, it was not easy. In a short time, he could barely make do with a hunter's intel.

speech_evidence.pattern: Philosophical reflection delivered internally, concise and cold
speech_evidence.example: Survival or death, this is the theme of nature.

decision_evidence.situation: Fang Yuan found no wild boars while scouting the mountain surroundings near the village.
decision_evidence.decision: He abandoned his current search area and changed course to the mountain foot.
decision_evidence.reasoning: He lacked scouting-type Gu, was unfamiliar with the environment, and the area was periodically cleared, making it too difficult to find boars there.
decision_evidence.outcome: He eventually found wild boar traces near the mountain foot and located a boar caught in a hunter's trap.

decision_evidence.situation: Fang Yuan discovered a beehive that could provide honey useful as Gu food.
decision_evidence.decision: He chose to route around the beehive and not attempt to harvest it.
decision_evidence.reasoning: Without the Bronze Skin Gu he lacked the protection needed to risk the bee stings, making the attempt not worth it.
decision_evidence.outcome: He continued his search without harvesting the honey.

decision_evidence.situation: Fang Yuan found a wild boar already trapped and bleeding in a hunter's pit trap.
decision_evidence.decision: He used a moonblade to kill the boar swiftly by cutting its neck.
decision_evidence.reasoning: The boar was already trapped and weakened; killing it was the efficient course of action to claim it.
decision_evidence.outcome: The boar bled out and died; Fang Yuan claimed the kill. Shortly after, hunters arrived and confronted him.

decision_evidence.situation: Fang Yuan recognized that hidden hunter traps were a threat to him throughout the mountain.
decision_evidence.decision: He resolved to seek out an old hunter and learn trap locations as well as wild beast activity areas.
decision_evidence.reasoning: Without a scouting Gu, gathering human intel was the next best solution to avoid traps and locate prey more efficiently.
decision_evidence.outcome: Decision made internally; not yet acted upon in this chapter.

personality_evidence.trait: Ruthlessness / willingness to kill without hesitation
personality_evidence.observation: Fang Yuan immediately attacks the hunters with a moonblade without warning when told to get lost, maiming one and killing Wang Er.
personality_evidence.quote: Get lost? Hearing Wang Er's words, Fang Yuan immediately broke into a cold smirk and he brandished his palm in front of him.

personality_evidence.observation: Fang Yuan deliberately closes the gap to nullify Wang Er's bow advantage, then exploits the sun's angle to blind Wang Er before firing the killing moonblade.
personality_evidence.quote: He used the angle of the sun's rays and caused a weakness in Wang Er, before shooting out his third moonblade.

personality_evidence.trait: Nihilistic view of life and death
personality_evidence.observation: After killing Wang Er, Fang Yuan reflects that all deaths are equal and meaningless, comparing a person's death to a pig's.
personality_evidence.quote: Life and death is nature's law. All living beings are equal, and everyone has their right to survive and be killed... in face of death, a person's death is no different from a pig's, what's the difference? They're both dead.

personality_evidence.observation: Fang Yuan's expression remains unchanging even as Wang Er's large fist approaches his face.
personality_evidence.quote: Fang Yuan could see the fist getting bigger in his eyes, but his expression was unchanging as he took a side step.

personality_evidence.observation: After the fight, Fang Yuan carefully analyses Wang Er's strengths and acknowledges he was a formidable opponent who would have defeated any other student.
personality_evidence.quote: This Wang Er is very strong, much stronger than that Mo family servant Gao Wan! If any other student encountered him, they would lose without doubt.

speech_evidence.pattern: Internal philosophical monologue equating human and animal death, reflecting moral indifference
speech_evidence.example: Life and death is nature's law. All living beings are equal, and everyone has their right to survive and be killed. There might be royalty and lower beings, but in face of death, a person's death is no different from a pig's, what's the difference? They're both dead.

speech_evidence.pattern: Cold, detached internal tactical analysis of an opponent's capabilities after killing them
speech_evidence.example: This Wang Er is truly skilled. His archery skill was fast and stable, just relying on this it could match moonblade... His fighting skill has reached the peak of mortals.

decision_evidence.situation: Wang Er tells Fang Yuan to get lost and readies his bow as a threat.
decision_evidence.decision: Fang Yuan immediately attacks without negotiation or warning, firing a moonblade and charging the group.
decision_evidence.reasoning: No reasoning is stated; the action is instinctive and immediate, suggesting he sees no reason to tolerate the threat.
decision_evidence.outcome: One hunter is maimed, the others kneel in submission, and Wang Er is eventually killed.

decision_evidence.situation: Wang Er has a bow with greater range than Fang Yuan's moonblade (10 metres vs bow range).
decision_evidence.decision: Fang Yuan abandons long-range combat and rushes in to close the distance, forcing Wang Er into melee.
decision_evidence.reasoning: He deduced he could not win a ranged exchange, so he removed Wang Er's range advantage by going close combat.
decision_evidence.outcome: Wang Er discards his bow and fights physically, putting him on ground Fang Yuan was prepared for.

decision_evidence.situation: Wang Er is physically far superior in size and strength for direct melee combat.
decision_evidence.decision: Fang Yuan feigns close combat but uses the sun's angle to blind Wang Er momentarily, then fires the killing moonblade.
decision_evidence.reasoning: He could not win a straight physical exchange with his fifteen-year-old body and no defensive Gu, so he created a situational weakness.
decision_evidence.outcome: Wang Er's vision is impaired; though he partially evades, the moonblade removes half his head, killing him.

personality_evidence.trait: Fearlessness / absence of reverence for authority
personality_evidence.observation: The academy elder notes that unlike other rebellious students who act from fear or impulse, Fang Yuan shows no fear whatsoever toward teachers or the clan system.
personality_evidence.quote: He had no fear in his heart at all, as if he had seen through the tricks of the academy.

personality_evidence.trait: Mastery of rules as a shield
personality_evidence.observation: Fang Yuan deliberately operates within the academy's rules, giving authorities no legitimate weakness to exploit.
personality_evidence.quote: He is proficient in the academy's rules, and normally will not commit any wrongdoings. Although he sleeps in class, once he is asked a question he can answer properly, leaving others with no flaws to pick on.

personality_evidence.observation: Even after openly defying his teacher and leaving the stage, Fang Yuan's expression does not change, treating the incident as insignificant.
personality_evidence.quote: His expression was aloof, and even after he left the stage, his expression showed no signs of changing, as if he had done something insignificant.

personality_evidence.observation: Fang Yuan rejects youngsters who try to attach themselves to him, only valuing those who are useful to him as pawns.
personality_evidence.quote: To him, only those who were useful were pawns, and these youngsters had too little value.

personality_evidence.observation: Fang Yuan stands alone at a corner of the arena, outside all three social factions, and does not wish for others to be near him.
personality_evidence.quote: Fang Yuan stood there alone, enshrouded in loneliness. He floated outside the factions.

personality_evidence.observation: The academy elder concludes that Fang Yuan's disrespect is not situational anger but an intrinsic characteristic.
personality_evidence.quote: This lad called Fang Yuan, he had a form of arrogance in his blood!

speech_evidence.pattern: Actions speak louder than words; his defiance is expressed through composed behaviour rather than heated speech
speech_evidence.example: Even with the heated competition, his expression did not change the slightest.

decision_evidence.situation: Other students try to attach themselves to Fang Yuan after witnessing his dominance in the arena.
decision_evidence.decision: Fang Yuan rejects all of them.
decision_evidence.reasoning: He considers them to have too little value as pawns; he only accepts those who are useful.
decision_evidence.outcome: Fang Yuan remains entirely alone, outside all social factions, with a vacant space around him.

decision_evidence.situation: Fang Yuan operates within the academy environment where teachers seek weaknesses to suppress him.
decision_evidence.decision: He studies and follows the academy's rules precisely, while still sleeping in class but answering questions correctly when asked.
decision_evidence.reasoning: By knowing the rules thoroughly he denies authority any legitimate pretext to punish him.
decision_evidence.outcome: The academy elder finds no exploitable weakness and feels helpless against him.
